title: ドキドキフルーツフェス

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I visit the cafe one day to find Mejiro Ryan and Ines Fujin sneaking around in an unusual manner.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh, geez… Is McQueen gonna be okay?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Come on, you can do it! Stay positive!

text_block_list.name: Ryan & Ines
text_block_list.text: Wha?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Shhh! Come over here, quickly!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan pulls me into the shadows, where they're both hiding. After getting my bearings, I follow their gaze to see…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: This fruit is remarkably juicy! I'm amazed!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes, the results are beyond what I'd imagined. I'm grateful to you for conducting the preliminary research, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: O-oh, it was nothing elaborate, really. Besides, I wanted to express my thanks to you for sharing your knowledge with me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen invited Ikuno out today so she could thank her for all her help.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ikuno was super excited for them both to eat a bunch of delicious desserts at this seasonal fruit dessert festival.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But McQueen's crazy nervous! And I was so worried about her that I just couldn't stay put!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: We can't abandon her in her moment of need!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I happened to spot her while at my part-time job, and I thought maybe there's something I can do to help!
choice_data_list: She seems to be having fun, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: No, look carefully! Her expression is slightly stiff. I bet she's thinking stuff like…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (I invited Ikuno to this dessert festival on a whim because I liked the sound of it, but is she actually enjoying herself?!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (Perhaps we should have gone someplace else, like that cleat store she likes?!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (The whole point of this outing was to thank her, after all!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That's definitely what she's thinking! There's no doubt in my mind!
choice_data_list: The Mejiro bond is nothing to sniff at…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I want to boost McQueen's confidence somehow! Isn't there anything we can do?!
choice_data_list: Let's utilize your position at your part-time job!
Let's help by using the Mejiro bond.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It's my time to shine, huh? Gotcha! I'll talk to the boss and see if we can offer them some special service!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wait, Ines! Put on this disguise! There's sunglasses, a wig, and a mask… This way you can serve them in secret!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Thanks! All right, here I go!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Server
text_block_list.text: Thanks a whole bunch for waiting. Here's your jumbo parfait for two.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Hm? I don't believe we ordered this.

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Server
text_block_list.text: This is a special item we're offering as part of the fruit festival. It's on the house.

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Server
text_block_list.text: It's fairly large, so if you hope to finish it all, you'll definitely need to spoon-feed it to each other!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Spoon-feed?!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Server
text_block_list.text: Yes, spoon-feed. Enjoy. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Sp-sp-spoon… Spoon-feed?! Like, while saying "open wide"? Is that what she meant?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: McQueen…

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Say "ahh."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Uh?! A-aaahh?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chomp.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Mmm… ♪

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: How does it taste?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Uh, hmm… The sweetness is filling my mouth… And I'm getting a warm feeling deep down in my chest!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Truly? I never realized you had such a fondness for desserts. I'm glad you like it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There was probably nothing to worry about in the first place, but it's nice that Ikuno Dictus appears to be having a great time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Understood! For McQueen, I'll work myself to the bone!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'll go borrow a uniform from my boss!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Thanks! I've also got some sunglasses and a wig I can use to disguise myself. Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Incognito Employee
text_block_list.text: Pardon me, valued customers, but today we're offering coupons to everyone attending the fruit festival.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …Hm?

text_block_list.name: Incognito Employee
text_block_list.text: Here's a discount for a sporting goods store. I hope the two of you will put it to good use.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Whatever are you doing, Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Incognito Employee
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Incognito Employee
text_block_list.text: I-I've been found out! But how?! I'm wearing a wig and everything!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It's painfully obvious who you are!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I've just noticed that Ines and Trainer are observing us from over there.

text_block_list.name: Ryan & Ines
text_block_list.text: Tactical retreat!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My word! What gives them the right to follow me around?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it must be nice being part of such a lively family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There was probably nothing to worry about in the first place, but it's nice to catch a quick glimpse of Ikuno Dictus enjoying herself.
